description: Take a graded session and fan the offline-conversion signal to whichever ad network the click came from. Looks up the session → click → network, loads the account's ad_network_creds for that network, and calls the right sender. Skips X grades (excluded) and any network without configured creds. Returns the per-network outcome.

session_id.description: UUID of the dr_sessions row to fan out

name: dr_fanout_grade
